## Summary of Changes

A clear description of what this PR introduces or fixes.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring
- [ ] `test`: Adding/updating tests
- [ ] `ci`: Build/CI pipeline changes

## Performance Checklist (Priority 1)

- [ ] Measured CPU usage (Verified < 1.5% during active playback)
- [ ] Measured RAM footprint (Verified < 40 MB)
- [ ] Verified background auto-pause (0.0% CPU/GPU when paused)
- [ ] Tested Universal Binary compilation (`arm64` and `x86_64`)
